# Land Rover FSK fixture (land_rover_fsk). Pulses cut from HackRF recordings of two real Land Rover keys at
# 315 MHz (2 Msps IQ, FM-demodulated at 250 ksps, one hop channel per train). The expected lines come from an
# independent decode of the same recordings (Manchester pairs, CRC-16 0x1021 over bytes 4..15).
# Format: "# train <label>", then "= <text>" per expected callback, then "<level 0|1> <duration us>" pulses.
